name: priya_shah
title: New Graduate Physical Therapist (DPT)
job_desc:
New Graduate Physical Therapist - Lakeshore Rehab Partners (Chicago, IL)
Our new grad residency-style program pairs you with a mentor for your first year across outpatient and inpatient settings.
Requirements: DPT from an accredited program (2027 graduates welcome); Illinois PT license or eligible; BLS. Strong clinical rotations in orthopedics and inpatient rehab, evidence-based practice, and clear documentation.

interview.question: Why should we hire a new graduate for this role?
interview.answer: I am eager to learn and I had good clinical rotations. I will work hard and take feedback well.

facts: By the end of her outpatient rotation Priya carried about 10 patients a day.
She reached 75% of a full caseload by week 6 of the inpatient rehab rotation.
Her capstone reviewed 18 studies on blood flow restriction training after ACL reconstruction.
She is eligible to sit for the NPTE in July 2027.
As an aide she supported a clinic seeing about 60 patients a day.
